pr_title: Allow pausing gameplay via middle mouse button
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/9531

Note that for the moment this just triggers standard "quit" behaviour (for cases like replays). This can change in the future once we have the ability to pause replays as well, but having the binding in place earlier is favourable IMO.
pr_comments:
In stable, the gameplay mouse buttons toggle disables this. I think lazer should do the same.

Also the hold to confirm is not working right. Pressing the middle button and releasing it will not cancel it.

issue_context.title: Add back ability to pause gameplay on middle mouse click
issue_context.body:
**Describe the new feature:** 
clicking the middle mouse button should instantly pause the current gameplay meaning, the button should react exactly like it did in stable.
comments: Did you meant the M4 Button by "middle mouse button"?. If so, you should already be able to pause gameplay with it. Check that M4 is bound in the key bindings setting (it should be bound by default to the back action)

Middle mouse is M3, I'm pretty sure. I did check and it does pause on stable, although I can't see it listed on the keybinding screen there.

We could add middle mouse as a default alternative binding for pause but I don't think it should be bypassing the hold-to-pause mechanics added in lazer.

Yes, i meant M3 (sorry for not clarifying enough)

Yes, i think its fine with the existing "hold-to-pause" settings. You can always set the time to zero so its all good. No need to bypass anything.

review_comments: as correctly pointed out by @Joehuu, this same case label should be also added in `OnReleased(GlobalAction)`.
